QUOTE: Under Valgrind memcheck or MSan, marked secrets are treated as uninitialised memory, so any secret-dependent branch or address shows up as an uninitialised-value error. The CI components are in `tests/scripts/components-sanitizers.sh`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the MSan/valgrind testing facility, but never says it is off by default or explicitly not part of the library API.
